cases.title: SharedObject persistence and AMF object graphs
checks: ByteArray AMF0/AMF3 round trips retain references/cycles, Date, named arrays and trailing records.
Collect saves both dialects; browser reload and publication Restart retain scores and shared identities.
Clear only this example’s named saves, reload to zero, then save once again; no callbacks or saves leak between publication sessions.

cases.title: Loaded images, LoaderInfo and legacy content replacement
checks: Embedded Loader, ByteArray loadBytes and AS2 MovieClipLoader display the original two images; legacy placeholder disappears.
Cycle swaps the image resources, then unloads to empty containers, then restores; visible loaded images accept clicks.
AS3 INIT precedes COMPLETE, AS2 complete precedes init; cancelled and failed decode probes stay separate from the valid scene. Restart resets all counts and callbacks.

cases.title: Vector masks, scroll rectangles and linked identity
checks: Only visible portions of the linked cards and masked panel accept clicks; the compound mask hole and exterior remain inactive.
Advance changes scroll and mask position, then removes masks; the same five card instances retain their identity and click counts.
AS2 setMask/scrollRect uses the same clipping; Restart restores fresh view, masks and callbacks.

cases.title: E4X selectors, editable XMLList targets and literals
checks: Both loaders show three catalog items and stock13, with namespace metadata and decoded entity text.

Update twice: AS3 edits attributes, creates a missing delivery node, replaces/deletes selected items and inserts a two-item literal fragment. Stock becomes15 then17; original stays3 items. AS2 DOM stock remains14 then13.

Literal order is ATB; escaped text stays text; child length and length() differ; ambiguous multi-parent edit is refused without changing the tree. Restart restores initial data and the next update runs revision1 once.

cases.title: Typed Vector models, Dictionary identity and enumeration
checks: Initial inventory shows INK4 / PAPER6 / FILM3, three typed models and three object keys. Vector JSON includes public stockLabel getters. AS2 for-in totals13.

Process batch updates quantities and reuses the shipped card for RESTOCK-1: PAPER7 / FILM4 / RESTOCK-1 quantity5, total16. Dictionary key removal is true; linked construction count stays3. A second batch totals17.
Restart restores original models/cards/keys; the next Process batch runs batch1 exactly once.

cases.title: 2D Transform, color and shared bitmap views
checks: Initial nested card visibly retains skew; two differently tinted views share one unchanged BitmapData. The AS2 strip uses Matrix, ColorTransform and a bound Transform.
Cycle first rotates/scales the rig without removing skew, tints its vector/text and reveals the cool bitmap transparent top row through alphaOffset.

Cycle again reparents the same linked card at its world matrix without repeating its constructor; third Cycle restores the rig. Restart restores the full original scene and the next Cycle runs phase one once.

cases.title: JSON, RegExp and AS2/AS3 Date data processing
checks: Embedded JSON becomes three normalized task codes/titles and UTC dates; the AS2 clock begins 2026-10-27.
Advance one day shifts all AS3 dates and the independent AS2 clock once while the report stays at 3 items / 13 hours. The serialized report includes the public summary getter.
Restart restores original dates and data; the next Advance reports day +1 exactly once.

cases.title: AS3 and AS2 complete-file Sound playback
checks: Both sound owners load the original MP3 and display matching byte totals/duration. The example keeps volume zero.
Play silently starts independent AS3/AS2 channels from a real gesture; both completion counters advance once. Stop suppresses later completion.
Restart resets counters and fresh sound owners; repeating Play silently produces one completion per dialect.

cases.title: Text boxes, TextFormat and independent AS3/AS2 cards
checks: The authored instruction TextBox and all three runtime text cards render; the second AS3 card is bold and italic while the AS2 card is teal.
Activate Cycle width + alignment twice: the first card narrows and centers, then widens and aligns right. Its scale stays one; the second AS3 card and AS2 card remain unchanged.
Restart restores initial width, left alignment, content and independent current/default formats with one control callback.

cases.title: Authored PNG, BitmapData and shared bitmap views
checks: The original PNG, two shared views, independent scroll/copy clone and AS2 attachBitmap image render with their labels.
Activate Paint shared pixels: both shared views change together, while the PNG source and independent clone stay unchanged.
Restart restores the initial pixels, fresh buffers and one paint callback.

cases.title: Portable resources, URLLoader and AS2 LoadVars
checks: Embedded text, form variables and the 50-byte binary packet update the stage; AS2 LoadVars completes with the decoded values.
The missing-resource branch is handled and the cancelled callback count stays zero.
Load HTTP notes fetches the exported README over HTTP and displays its status/length; Restart resets loaders and repeats the embedded pipeline.

cases.title: Linked MovieClips, independent timelines and attachMovie
checks: Two AS3 instances share one exported symbol but keep separate child identities, frames and click counts; the AS2 instance sees its initObject during construction.
Click all three cards; Right steps the AS3 clips, Space detaches/reattaches the middle clip and Up uses frame labels. Nested badges keep independent clocks.
Restart creates fresh linked instances, counters and listeners.

cases.title: AS3 interface contracts and property accessors
checks: The component model implements inherited project interfaces and typed accessors, including a subclass getter using super.
Click the stage to update the bounded model through its property; the independent second model remains at seven and the first stops at nine.
Restart restores initial instance and static property state.

cases.title: Gradient fills, strokes and shared vector Graphics
checks: The AS3 card has a linear fill, gradient outline and radial badge; the warm underlay has unequal round corners, the right panel has a cubic wave, and AS2 draws a purple gradient triangle.
Click the card to change its palette, use Right / Space / Up to reparent, detach/reattach and cycle it; identity and click count survive.
Click the AS2 triangle; Restart restores the initial gradient palette, fresh card counts and timer state.

cases.title: ByteArray binary packet and text output
checks: The ordinary project writes, reads and copies its binary/UTF packet and displays the expected decoded values.
Restart repeats the result using fresh session buffers.

cases.title: Geometry, Timer and live display updates
checks: Four Timer ticks transform a Point with Matrix, move the marker and update the text using typed display bounds.
Timer completion reports four ticks and a stopped timer; Restart starts a fresh four-tick sequence.

cases.title: AS2 classes, inherited MovieClips and shared input
checks: Click both cards: inherited onPress changes each count independently and updates the shared total.
Left/Right activate the corresponding card; Space resets both; H/S hide and restore the stage cursor.
Restart restores two fresh instances, zero shared total and one set of input listeners.

cases.title: AS2 / AS3 data processing and text output
checks: Run both leaderboards: both show Zoe:45, Ada:30 and Bob:20 in the expected order; AS3 also shows Total:95.
The result labels update on the stage with their new colors, while the final traces report the array pipeline results.
Restart restores the authored labels; rerunning produces the same results.

cases.title: Project classes, linked instances and shared state
checks: Both linked cards initialize before the document class uses them.
Click both cards: independent counts and shared total update; Space resets them.
Restart clears class/static state and listeners without duplicate callbacks.

cases.title: MovieClip / DisplayObject family
checks: Inspect, resize, rotate and rename report coherent bounds, coordinates and child identity.
Pressing the cyan clip invokes its AS2 callback; stopping callbacks preserves independent timeline playback.

cases.title: Stage, events and input
checks: Click the blue pad and inspect capture/target/bubble output.
Toggle the listener with the orange pad, then repeat; arrow keys move the blue pad.
Restart clears listeners and focus, and restores the initial frame rate.

cases.title: Visibility and nested lifecycle
checks: Hide and restore the clip: pixels and semantic targets agree while its nested clock continues.

cases.title: AS2 / AS3 value profiles
checks: The ordinary export produces its expected intrinsic traces and repeats them after Restart.

cases.title: Keyboard and semantic HTML5 controls
checks: Tab navigation and Enter/Space activation remain usable at a narrow viewport.

cases.title: Vector geometry
checks: Curves, compound fills and transformed geometry render without runtime errors.

cases.title: Nested animation
checks: Independent nested animation and playback controls still work.
